source_read_scope.note: One S029 request occurred after shared phase03 closure and is preserved as a procedural incident; it returned no body. S009 received one individually gated exact-URL request after full Kloop-origin review; it returned no body. No retries or alternate routes.

coverage_assessment: First-pass discovery is recorded from 21 actual search actions across English, Russian, Kyrgyz and local/regional outlets; all 21 action IDs, original query batches and ordered non-snippet headers were compared with the registered rollout (475 headers, zero mismatches). Two opened report bodies support separate Feb 1 gatherings whose turnout remains unknown, so both candidates stay pending threshold. RFE/RL reports approximately 30 demonstrators in Bishkek on Feb 10, below 50; E007 is retained as an exclusion. Other leads remain search-only or unverified. Two additional gated exact-URL attempts returned cache misses without article bodies. The web search corpus is not LexisNexis-equivalent and cannot establish that no other gatherings occurred; less-indexed district, workplace and Kyrgyz-language reporting and the official baseline remain pending.
